Name: MoveGain
Note: Full movement input from about 21% past the dead zone (the original joystick at 60 fps)

Name: YawRate
Note: Degrees per second at full tilt (FOV 90; sensitivity 1)

Name: PitchRate
Note: Degrees per second at full tilt

Name: LookExponent
Note: Response curve; above 1 gives finer aim near center

Name: HoldSeconds
Note: Tap or hold: a press held this long is a hold (FaceLeft drops tainted; D-pad up opens team chat)

Name: TurnAroundSeconds
Note: LeftTrigger: how long the 180-degree turn takes
